name: Separator
description: Radix Separator. Decorative by default, which keeps it out of the accessibility tree.
intent: A visible break between groups, without implying they are different kinds of thing.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

props.name: orientation
props.hint: Accepted by this component and passed to the underlying primitive. Named in the component signature, so it is part of this surface.

props.hint: Accepted by this component and passed to the underlying primitive. Named in the component signature, so it is part of this surface.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

notes: decorative defaults to true, which sets role="none" and keeps it out of the accessibility tree. That is right for visual grouping.
Set decorative={false} only when the separation carries meaning a screen-reader user would otherwise miss.
A vertical separator needs a parent with a resolved height, or it collapses to nothing.

forbiddenUsage: Vertical separator in a parent with no height
agentRules: Leave decorative true unless the break is semantically meaningful.
Vertical separators need a parent height.
Prefer spacing over rules when either would work.
